text: In the reservoir-computing interpretation of the cerebellum, the vast layer of granule cells plays the role of the high-dimensional reservoir, while the ___ cells act as the trained linear readout (with climbing fibers supplying the error signal).
explanation: The Marr-Albus-Ito / reservoir mapping is: granule cells = reservoir (a ~500-fold dimensionality expansion of the mossy-fiber input), Purkinje cells = linear readout, and climbing fibers = teacher/error signal driving LTD at parallel-fiber-to-Purkinje synapses. So the readout cells are the Purkinje cells.
